scripts.build: bun run --filter @calcifer-design/tokens build && bun run --filter @calcifer-design/ui build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @calcifer-design/tokens build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.storybook: bun run --filter @calcifer-design/tokens build && bun run --filter @calcifer-design/ui storybook
scripts.storybook:build: bun run --filter @calcifer-design/tokens build && bun run --filter @calcifer-design/ui storybook:build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:dist && bun run storybook:build
